profile.headline: Software Engineer 🧑🏻‍💻
profile.summary: Since graduating from the University of the Arts, in Philadelphia in 2014, I have had some great experiences in stage and screen productions over the past decade.  During this time, I have had to support myself through work in the food service industry, mainly in restaurants as a bartender.  While the service industry is a perfect platform to support artists, at this point I want to find a career that challenges my interests as an artist, but also fuels my passion for learning and Web Development.  Creatively, I want to work with Front End Languages as well as Design.  I would like to share my skills and talents in any capacity within your organization.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Works in an agile, and collaborative environment across software architecture, understanding both front-end

and back-end concerns, while specializing in the front-end. Works closely with designers to take wireframes

from conception to implementation and work closely with back-end developers to ensure implemented UI code

is unit tested and production-code ready. Codes user interfaces, including interactions, responsive layouts, and

styling. Uses and contributes to the IBM Design System to implement and maintain UIs. Ensures user interfaces

are accessible and enhance the performance of the application. Works in programming languages like

JavaScript, Node.js or frameworks such as React, Vue or Angular. Skilled in UI development technologies such as

HTML, CSS, JSON and API usage.

positions.title: Software Engineering Technical Coach
positions.description: Providing conceptual, coding, and debugging skills with JavaScript, React, Sinatra, Ruby, and Rails to students in the Software Engineering program at Flatiron School.

positions.title: Information Technology Recruiter
positions.description:
Workbridge Associates is a professional IT recruitment agency that specializes in matching top IT professionals with organizations of all sizes that offer rewarding full-time and contract career opportunities. With a deep understanding of the most promising technologies being used in today’s world, we fit seamlessly in the technology markets of the ten major North American cities we operate in. Unlike typical IT staffing agencies, we go the extra mile to show not only our commitment to candidates looking to progress their careers, but to the tech community as a whole.

Workbridge is a proud creator of Tech in Motion, a national event series that connects tech enthusiasts in the cities we operate in. Tech in Motion helps make real, human connections between tech companies and the candidates they are looking for. In every engagement, we take a personalized recruitment approach and meet with each candidate individually to understand their needs for a successful match. We pride ourselves in becoming an extended resource for you to further progress in your profession, so let our tech recruitment expertise assist you in taking the next step in your career.

positions.title: Bartender
positions.description: Bartender at a high-end tequila bar with creative cocktails and an extensive menu of Mexican/Colombian food.  Duties for opening were arranging and setting up the bar, prep for the day and night shift.  Duties during the shift included service well, To Go Orders, a thirteen-seat bar and 3-5 table section.  Cash handling was done before, during, and after each shift.

positions.title: Bartender
positions.description: Providing quality customer service and excellent craftsmanship in bartending to all customers in a high-volume restaurant in the Downtown area of Raleigh. Duties included serving customers, basic bartending to craft bartending, stocking every night, nightly cleaning routines, cash handling throughout the shift and at closing.

positions.title: Bartender R
positions.description: Creating and producing the newest cocktails and the classics for customers in and around Koreatown.  Maintaining a clean bar, including FOH and BOH and the bar itself, glassware and essential tools. Support main bartender to maintain high level of customer service during peak hours. Opening duties: setting up the bartenders. Closing duties included:  burning wells, stocking and restocking beer, liquor, fresh juices and syrups, and garnishes, cash handling sales and night bank drop.

positions.title: Senior Retail Associate
positions.description: Providing excellent customer service for guests in the greater Los Angeles area.  Duties included: inventory knowledge, maintaining a presentable floor for customers, opening and closing duties, as well as, major cash handling responsibilities.
